scope: Isolated renderer A/B for a deterministic 50v50 Frontline scene; no policies or policy evaluation

commands.reference_template: timeout 180s flock -x artifacts/deadline-experiment/benchmark.lock env __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1 __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia .venv/bin/python benchmarks/gpu_renderer_benchmark.py --arm reference --device cuda --warmup 20 --samples 100 --out docs/engineering/performance-experiments/gpu-renderer-ab-pairN-reference.json
commands.gpu_template: timeout 180s flock -x artifacts/deadline-experiment/benchmark.lock env __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1 __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia .venv/bin/python benchmarks/gpu_renderer_benchmark.py --arm gpu --device cuda --moderngl-path /tmp/bnb-deadline-moderngl --warmup 20 --samples 100 --out docs/engineering/performance-experiments/gpu-renderer-ab-pairN-gpu.json

reference.scope: GameRenderer._draw_frame; offscreen; excludes event polling and display flip

gpu.scope: one-transfer immutable snapshot extraction plus FrontlineGPURenderer.render, including display flip

cuda_memory_note: Both arms retained the same environment allocation: 199680 allocated bytes and 331350016 reserved bytes after the run. Process RSS is the more relevant renderer delta, but separate processes make it descriptive rather than causal.

correctness.tests: 10 snapshot, toroidal interpolation, visibility, ring-reuse, fog geometry, and one-transfer contract tests passed
correctness.actual_context: RTX 4070 OpenGL 4.6 context and a full team-fog frame succeeded
correctness.limitations: The prototype carries authoritative transforms, all projectile ring slots, visibility masks, fields, zones, capture progress, health, and fog inputs, but it does not yet draw health/shield UI, trails, or capture-progress styling. Its point-primitive map rendering can clip very large disks. It is not yet a drop-in presentation replacement.

decision: defer integration; retain the prototype and snapshot boundary because the renderer signal is large and repeatable, but complete visual-information parity is unfinished
